feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 May 2026 4:01pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 11 May 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure over the Irish Sea is slowly displaced by a frontal system approaching from the northwest.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, quickly settling northwest 3 or 4 and occasionally 5 in the north. Backing west 4 or 5 overnight, increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning then veering northwest.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Fair to start, then a few outbreaks of rain overnight before clearing to showers tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6, backing west 5 or 6 in all waters in the evening, veering west or northwest 6 or 7 on Wednesday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming frequent later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
